verdict.rationale: Ollama ships an official `ollama` CLI. First-party docs describe the `ollama launch` command, which sets up and runs Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex with local or cloud models in one command. Community users corroborate everyday use of `ollama run --verbose`, `ollama pull` and `ollama rm` for model management. Missing for 10: a full first-party CLI command reference, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as structured or JSON output for scripting.
